messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — HIGH error rate detected for route /v1/generate in canary pool "canary-eu-2". Error: tokenizer decode failures. Rate: 18% over 5m. Affected image: model/redwood:v3.1.2. Paging ml-oncall and sre-oncall.

sam: I'm on it. grabbing logs now.

sam: @emily can you take ML oncall? seeing tokenizer decode failures "invalid token id" from pods running v3.1.2.

emily: taking ML oncall. oncall to confirm — was canary at 10% traffic to v3.1.2?

sam: yes, canary started ~12:05 UTC. spike showed up ~12:17.

jordan: seeing gateway 500s -> 502s from inference svc. short sample: 
```
E 12:17:34 inference: tokenizer.decode failed: unknown byte sequence at position 421
stack: model_infer->decode->kv_cache
```

maria: quick customer-impact note: errors ~= 18% of canary traffic (~120k reqs in 5m, ~21k errors). production fleet still on v3.1.1. Not yet widespread but trending.

emily: recommend immediate kill of rollout flag and rollback canary to v3.1.1. Sam can you flip the flag? I'll stage rollback config.

sam: flipping feature flag now -> SUCCESS. rollout/model-v3-1-2=false

ops-bot: feature flag change recorded: rollout/model-v3-1-2 set to false by sam at 12:22:13 UTC.

sam: triggering canary reassign to v3.1.1 for all canary traffic.

deploy-bot: canary pool "canary-eu-2" traffic rebalanced: v3.1.1 -> 100% (was 10% v3.1.2). Action started at 12:22:40 UTC.

jordan: observing error rate fall — 12:23 minute window shows errors down to 0.6%. rollback appears effective.

maria: customer impact tally: two enterprise tenants reported increased 500s in last 15m. Support has been notified. No SLO breach yet; recommend 30m watch.

emily: kicking off artifact validation for v3.1.2 — suspect either weightset mismatch or a tokenizer binary/build change. Capturing failing example for root-cause:
```
input: "Translate: π ≈ 3."
error: tokenizer.decode exception: byte 0xCF at pos 5
```

sam: pulling release artifact checksums now. preliminary: v3.1.2 weight manifest checksum DOES NOT match the artifact in the staging registry. Opening ticket against release pipeline.

sam: tagging follow-ups: on incident board -> IAL-431 reconcile weight packing + tokenizer ABI.

maria: I'll take customer comms. Drafting message: "We observed a canary rollout that introduced tokenizer decode errors for a subset of requests. We rolled back the canary to v3.1.1; traffic is back to normal while we investigate."

emily: assigning deploy/packaging team to run binary diff + checksum sweep across registries. Also, run a targeted tokenizer test suite against the v3.1.2 artifact.

sam: handoff note — leaving for night oncall in 30m. Summary: rollback completed, flag off, customers notified, artifacts under investigation.

jordan: acknowledged. will monitor the canary pool and escalate if errors reappear.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated (status: mitigated) — marked by sam at 12:46:02 UTC. Postmortem requested and follow-ups assigned.

sam: next steps: 1) deploy team to verify registry integrity and fix release pipeline (urgent), 2) ML team to reproduce tokenizer failure locally with failing corpora, 3) customer comms complete and support follow-ups. Posting links to logs and ticket in incident board.

maria: on it, will coordinate notes with support and draft a short postmortem summary for execs.

emily: will own RCA writeup; will include checksum diffs, packaging logs, and unit test gaps.

sam: thanks everyone. leaving channel for handoff.
